instruction: Replace the model-authored closed-answer draft with a deterministic compiler path that selects validated supports, extracts only text directly present in those records, builds a complete evidence-indexed answer, finalizes it internally, and emits the exact public contract in one command. Make successful stdout terminal; after any execution-tool failure, forbid every fallback tool or knowledge read so orchestration can classify the external failure. Preserve exact request bindings and fail closed without task, corpus, evaluator, or holdout constants.

donorTraces.contribution: exact evidence-clause binding, distinct-authority planning, deterministic evidence canonicalization, and terminal failure handling

properties: expose one closed-answer command and compose the complete draft internally
prefer reviewed claim-ready records by generic paper or source identity with a safe all-record fallback
derive every claim statement from text present in its committed record body
bind the exact request, selection policy, breadth contract, dimensions, and supports
canonicalize evidence and emit the closed public contract as terminal stdout
stop after the first command or execution-tool failure without another knowledge or fallback call
